components.explanation: Clip A, wind_key_cycle (the cycle): Sprite2D + AnimationPlayer discrete frame track, 8 keys at 8 fps, LOOP_LINEAR, no key at length; KeyAnimPlayer is the one writer of key_sprite.frame.

Clip B, jab_action (the committing action): cutout rig keyed as resource text, three value tracks on BodyPivot (position:x, rotation) and KeyBob (position:y), keys at frames 0/3/5/10/11/21 of the 60 fps phase table, LOOP_NONE, step 1/60; revisions 1 (transition) and 2 (frame-11 pose).

The named rig and its one authority per node in fighter.gd (_ready, _apply_pose), both players MANUAL and put at state_t by _sync_clips at the end of step and on state_changed (the seam fix advances forward); SteamMount (A6) now only reads KeyMount.
The 8 x 1 key sheets (84 x 60 cells) written by generate_key_sheets.gd from the A2 key art, their import sidecars and ATTRIBUTION.md (source, licence).
Fixtures, not part of the game: jab_preview (the strips r0-r2, --clocks) and key_cycle_preview (the seam).
A7 tests: the two read-backs (26, 58), structure and state (57), edges (70), pins (49), and the four planned pin updates in test_slice.gd and test_wind_steam_state.gd.

sources.text:
## A7 cutout rig (CHANGE-BRIEF.md §1, §7): fixed names so clip tracks can point at
## them. Fighter/FacingPivot/BodyPivot/{sprite, KeyMount/KeyBob/key_sprite}, and
## weapon directly under Fighter. One writer per node (CLAUDE.md, One authority).
var facing_pivot: Node2D   # _apply_pose: scale.x = facing
var body_pivot: Node2D     # FighterAnimPlayer (jab_action): position.x, rotation
var sprite: Sprite2D       # _apply_pose: texture, scale (no facing), offset
var key_mount: Node2D      # _apply_pose: position (anchor, no facing), visible
var key_bob: Node2D        # FighterAnimPlayer (jab_action): position.y
var key_sprite: Sprite2D   # KeyAnimPlayer (wind_key_cycle): frame
var weapon: Sprite2D       # _apply_pose, as before A7

source_view_code_result_pairs.observation: test_a7_structure section A (re-run): after setup the only code writes to the rig are _apply_pose's FacingPivot.scale and KeyMount.position/visible; pose = clip value, largest gap 0.

sources.text:
| Phase | Frames (at 60 fps) | Frame phase begins on | What the player may do | What the game reads in each phase |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Startup** | `0..4` (5 frames) | Frame `0` (tick `0`) | Nothing (`_attack` reads no intent; `just_pressed` is not buffered; a jab press in `0..4` is lost) | `Fighter.state == S.JAB`; `state_t = 0.0000 s` on tick `0` and `0.0667 s` on tick `4` (both less than `startup = 0.07 s`), so the attack hitbox remains closed across ticks `0..4` |
| **Active (box live)** | `5..10` (6 frames) | Frame `5` (tick `5`) | Nothing (new attack/move/block/rewind inputs are ignored and lost) | On tick `5`, `state_t` reaches `0.0833 s` (at or above `0.07 s`), opening the hitbox (`startup` at or below `state_t` and `state_t` less than `startup + active`) and checking for hits on every tick `5..10` (`fighter.gd:117-125, 192-198`) |
| **Recovery** | `11..20` (10 frames) | Frame `11` (tick `11`) | Nothing until tick `21` (`state_t` at or above `0.35 s`), when state transitions to `IDLE` (or `EMPTY` if `wind` is zero or less); because `_neutral` does not run on tick `21`, a press landing on tick `21` is also lost, and neutral input is first read on tick `22` | `state_t` advancing past `startup + active`; exit check `state_t` at or above `startup + active + recovery` (`fighter.gd:199-200`) |

| Key | Source frame (§4) | Phase boundary | Time in `.tres` (s) | Exact frame ÷ 60 (s) | `BodyPivot:position:x` | `BodyPivot:rotation` | `KeyBob:position:y` | Outgoing transition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | startup begins (entry, rest) | 0 | 0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.5 (ease-out) |
| 1 | 3 | inside startup: coil peak | 0.05 | 0.050000 | −6.0 | −0.10 | +2.0 | 2.0 (ease-in) |
| 2 | 5 | **active begins** | 0.0833333 | 0.083333… | +14.0 | +0.12 | −2.0 | 1.0 (linear, hold) |
| 3 | 10 | last active frame | 0.1666667 | 0.166666… | +14.0 | +0.12 | −2.0 | 1.0 (linear) |
| 4 | 11 | **recovery begins** | 0.1833333 | 0.183333… | +12.0 (was +8.0 until revision 2) | +0.10 (was +0.05) | −1.75 (was −1.0) | 1.0 (linear; was 0.5 ease-out until revision 1, 2026-11-22) |
| 5 | 21 | **end: back to IDLE, rest** | 0.35 | 0.350000 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 | 1.0 (no segment after) |

source_view_code_result_pairs.observation: Fixture strip r0 at each phase boundary: coil on 13, lunge on 15 (box opens), hold to 20, release on 21, idle on 31; Tharun's first look.
The two committed 672 x 60 sheets, 8 x 1 cells; cells 2 and 6 at the 0.15 minimum; cell centres 41.5 / 42.0 of 84 (A7-9c).
